name: Tread.fi
description:
TREAD is a token used within tread.fi, an algorithmic trading terminal and agentic trading ecosystem for digital asset markets. As the ecosystem grows, TREAD is the token that ties it together, connecting the traders, builders, and exchanges that use the platform. Official information about TREAD will come only from the Tread Foundation and on X @treadfoundation.

tread.fi gives traders institutional-grade execution and autonomous agents that operate across venues, bringing professional trading infrastructure to a wider market for the first time.
